items.text: Houston (final report + Sat update): OUT - DE Danielle Hunter (hamstring), LB Azeez Al-Shaair (groin/personal), WR Marvin Harrison Jr. (hamstring), TE Brevin Jordan (finger/foot), G Keylan Rutledge (neck/shoulder), RB David Montgomery (groin, ruled out Sat; Woody Marks stays RB1). QUESTIONABLE - DE Will Anderson Jr. (ankle), OT Trent Brown (illness/wrist), G Wyatt Teller (back/illness), LB Jacob Hummel (groin), CB Jaylin Smith (hamstring). C.J. Stroud starts.
items.source: CBS Sports (NFL Week 10 injury report: final game statuses, Nov 13)

items.text: Cleveland (final report): OUT - S Ronnie Hickman Jr. (concussion), FB Michael Burton (calf). QUESTIONABLE - WR Denzel Boston (toe, leading receiver). Deshaun Watson (cleared concussion protocol) starts over Shedeur Sanders, per HC Todd Monken; matches the schedule.
